- 2026-09-15T13:12:57.758Z — rule: **Never hard-delete traveller-made rows or add confirm dialogs: soft-delete via lib/server/deletions.ts (register the table in SOFT_DELETE_TABLES) and filter `deleted_at IS NULL` in every list, total and suggestion.** — chose **App-wide soft delete + undo: every traveller-made table gets `deleted_at TEXT` and `deletion_id INTEGER` columns; a DELETE writes one row to a `deletions` journal (id AUTOINCREMENT, kind, entity_id, label, deleted_at, undone_at) and stamps every affected row (including future cascades) with that deletion_id. POST /api/undo restores the most recent not-yet-undone deletion (a stack: repeated undo walks back further) by clearing deleted_at/deletion_id in every table registered in SOFT_DELETE_TABLES (apps/web/lib/server/deletions.ts), returns 200 { restored: { kind, id, label } }; 409 nothing_to_undo when the journal has nothing left.
